en.summary: A package that routes a prompt to the backend that fits the task, and falls back to a local model when no API key is available.
en.role: Maintainer. 61 of the 72 commits are mine. Seven releases are on npm, with CI on GitHub.
en.built: The backend-registry refactor ran as reviewed agent tasks. Sixteen task reviews passed it. The final whole-branch review found a critical regression: a documented fallback had silently broken.
en.figure: Simplified design diagram. The dashed path is the degradation route that the final review found broken.
